# Leap Studio — Creative Agency Landing Page

## Overview

Build a single-page dark-mode website for **Leap Studio**, a global creative agency positioning itself as a reinvention and experience partner for enterprise clients. The site must feel **bold, modern, and elegant** — think high-end design studio meets tech-forward consultancy. The audience is brand leaders and innovation teams at large organizations, so every pixel should communicate confidence, sophistication, and global scale.

## Visual Direction

- **Dark mode is the default and only mode.** Use a near-black background (#0A0A0A or similar) with crisp white typography and selective accent colors — think electric blue or warm amber for interactive highlights.
- **Typography:** Use a modern sans-serif (Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk, or similar). Hero headlines should be large and commanding; body text clean and readable against dark backgrounds.
- **Imagery:** Use placeholder images with muted, cinematic tones. Project cards and team photos should feel editorial.
- **Spacing:** Generous whitespace. Let sections breathe — this is a premium brand.

## Key Priorities

1. **The region-toggle team carousel is the most complex interaction.** Four region tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) must filter team member cards, each showing a photo, quote, title, and office location. Get this right — it demonstrates the agency's global footprint.
2. **The hero carousel** sets the tone for the entire page. Transitions should feel smooth and intentional, cycling through featured content cards.
3. **Work showcase** — the horizontal-scrolling project cards are a core selling point. Each case study needs a strong visual thumbnail paired with its title.
4. **The language selector dropdown** and **cookie consent banner** are smaller but must function correctly as toggles.
5. **Responsive design is mandatory.** Carousels should adapt gracefully to mobile (swipe-friendly), and the navigation should collapse appropriately.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section order, all interaction definitions, data content, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

1	# Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner
2	
3	## Brand
4	Leap Studio is a global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era. Part of Meridian Consulting Group, Leap Studio fuses design, strategy, and technology across 30+ studios worldwide to help enterprise clients navigate the dual transition of sustainability and digital innovation.
5	
6	Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #FFFFFF (white), #808080 (neutral gray)
7	
8	Dark mode: Yes (default). Typography: bold, modern, elegant. Tone: confident and visionary.
9	
10	## Hero Content
11	The hero is a multi-slide carousel featuring rotating content cards:
12	
13	- **Slide 1 — Futurescape: Synthetic Realities** — "Welcome to the Futurescape. Discover trends and insights on the future of human-AI chemistry." CTA: "Read the report"
14	- **Slide 2 — Designing Robots for Human Spaces** — "Meet 'Aura,' a concept from Leap Studio that offers a human-centered approach to physical AI." CTA: "Explore the work"
15	- **Slide 3 — Amplifying Clinical Care with AI** — "Examining how service design helps experts understand the healthcare ecosystem." CTA: "Explore now"
16	- **Slide 4 — Design Mind Leapcast Ep. 55** — "Peter Hallström, Global Head of Design at Lumina Health, discusses the evolution of product design and the role of design leadership." CTA: "Listen now"
17	- **Slide 5 — From Complexity to Clarity** — "Dive into new research on how CMOs can reclaim marketing to build competitive edge." CTA: "Read the report"
18	
19	## Global Studios
20	Section title: "Welcome to the studio"
21	Subtitle: "Meet the team making an impact for leading brands around the globe."
22	
23	Region tabs: **North America** · **Asia** · **Europe** · **Oceania**
24	
25	| Name | Title | Office | Quote |
26	|------|-------|--------|-------|
27	| Denice Alvarez | Office Manager | New York | "As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers." |
28	| Marco Bellini | Design Director | San Francisco | "Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make." |
29	| Priya Mehta | Studio Head | Bangalore | "We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm." |
30	| Thierry Lam | Design Lead | Singapore | "Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless." |
31	| Gavin Hartley | Managing Director | London | "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results." |
32	| Francesca Terzi | Design Director | Munich | "At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life." |
33	| Jacintha Soo Ho | Senior Manager, CX Transformation | Melbourne | "I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven't thought of before." |
34	
35	Each card includes a CTA: "Contact Leap Studio [City]"
36	
37	## Client Work
38	Section title: "Our work"
39	Subtitle: "Reinvent your business and realize exceptional experiences that win hearts and move markets."
40	
41	Featured projects:
42	
43	1. **Unilever — Creating Consumer Insights at Scale** — "The PDC provides insight not only to marketing, but also to supply chain, R&D, HR and finance. Thanks to the collaboration with Leap Studio we now have the capability to provide insight and action all across the organisation." — Alex Owens, VP, Global Head of People Data Centres, Unilever
44	2. **IKEA Retail (Ingka Group) — Deepening Customer Engagement**
45	3. **Volvo Group — Harnessing Data for Leaner and Greener Future of Mobility**
46	4. **Chase Payment Solutions — Modernizing the Point-of-Sale Experience**
47	5. **Tiffany & Co. — Reimagining Luxury Craftsmanship** — "We valued the truly collaborative process from conception to delivery. The resulting experience beautifully emphasizes our core brand codes of craftsmanship and heritage, while effectively leveraging new AI technologies." — Thomas Arnold, Digital Experience Design & Innovation Director
48	6. **Majid Al Futtaim / Carrefour — Helping Healthier Habits Stick** — "Our 'Pick Your 5' framework, based on your behavior change strategy, is going to be instrumental in driving positive outcomes." — Sheila Chaiban, Global CMO
49	
50	Additional projects: Designing Robots for Human Spaces · Harboring Culture Year-Round (Destination NSW)
51	
52	## CTA Banner
53	Title: "Let's work together"
54	Body: "Reach out to our global team to imagine, make and scale new products, services, experiences, business models, ventures and ways of working."
55	CTA: "Get in touch"
56	
57	## How We Work
58	Headline: **Advancing people and planet**
59	Body: "The disruptive forces of emerging technologies and sustainable objectives present a reinvention imperative for businesses—and the potential to create entirely new dimensions of value. Navigate the dual transition of the eco-digital era with innovative solutions to today's biggest challenges."
60	CTA: "Explore our services"
61	
62	## Latest Insights
63	Section title: "Latest insights"
64	Subtitle: "Explore research, provocations and perspectives on trends across technology, creativity, business and culture."
65	
66	| Type | Title | CTA |
67	|------|-------|-----|
68	| Podcast | Ep. 58 — When Human Connection Meets AI | Listen |
69	| Podcast | Ep. 57 — Writing the Future of AI | Listen |
70	| Article | Amplifying Clinical Care with AI | Read |
71	| Podcast | Ep. 56 — The Future of Customer Experience | Listen |
72	| Article | Next-Gen Contact Centers: Powered by AI | Read |
73	| Article | The AI-Empowered Marketer | Read |
74	| Podcast | Ep. 55 — What Makes a Product Great? | Listen |
75	| Insight Report | From Complexity to Clarity | Download |
76	
77	## Our Principles
78	
79	1. **Challenge the status quo** — From launching game-changing products and services to redefining business as usual, our work bridges the gap between what could be and what should be.
80	2. **Fuse art & science to make ideas real** — We innovate with equal parts expertise in creativity and transformation, leveraging next-level data and tech to elevate experiences for all.
81	3. **Create a lasting impact at global scale** — Driving meaningful outcomes starts with reimagining systems at a fundamental level. As part of Meridian Consulting, we bring a global reach and diverse skillsets to our approach.
82	4. **Regenerate systems & communities** — In the eco-digital era, we believe every collaboration is an opportunity to create social, economic and environmental value for all.
83

85	Primary: Insights · Work · Services · Culture · Make Your Mark · Contact Us

# Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner

## Brand
Leap Studio is a global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era. Part of Meridian Consulting Group, Leap Studio fuses design, strategy, and technology across 30+ studios worldwide to help enterprise clients navigate the dual transition of sustainability and digital innovation.

Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #FFFFFF (white), #808080 (neutral gray)

Dark mode: Yes (default). Typography: bold, modern, elegant. Tone: confident and visionary.

## Hero Content
The hero is a multi-slide carousel featuring rotating content cards:

- **Slide 1 — Futurescape: Synthetic Realities** — "Welcome to the Futurescape. Discover trends and insights on the future of human-AI chemistry." CTA: "Read the report"
- **Slide 2 — Designing Robots for Human Spaces** — "Meet 'Aura,' a concept from Leap Studio that offers a human-centered approach to physical AI." CTA: "Explore the work"
- **Slide 3 — Amplifying Clinical Care with AI** — "Examining how service design helps experts understand the healthcare ecosystem." CTA: "Explore now"
- **Slide 4 — Design Mind Leapcast Ep. 55** — "Peter Hallström, Global Head of Design at Lumina Health, discusses the evolution of product design and the role of design leadership." CTA: "Listen now"
- **Slide 5 — From Complexity to Clarity** — "Dive into new research on how CMOs can reclaim marketing to build competitive edge." CTA: "Read the report"

## Global Studios
Section title: "Welcome to the studio"
Subtitle: "Meet the team making an impact for leading brands around the globe."

Region tabs: **North America** · **Asia** · **Europe** · **Oceania**

| Name | Title | Office | Quote |
|------|-------|--------|-------|
| Denice Alvarez | Office Manager | New York | "As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers." |
| Marco Bellini | Design Director | San Francisco | "Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make." |
| Priya Mehta | Studio Head | Bangalore | "We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm." |
| Thierry Lam | Design Lead | Singapore | "Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless." |
| Gavin Hartley | Managing Director | London | "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results." |
| Francesca Terzi | Design Director | Munich | "At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life." |
| Jacintha Soo Ho | Senior Manager, CX Transformation | Melbourne | "I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven't thought of before." |

Each card includes a CTA: "Contact Leap Studio [City]"

## Client Work
Section title: "Our work"
Subtitle: "Reinvent your business and realize exceptional experiences that win hearts and move markets."

Featured projects:

1. **Unilever — Creating Consumer Insights at Scale** — "The PDC provides insight not only to marketing, but also to supply chain, R&D, HR and finance. Thanks to the collaboration with Leap Studio we now have the capability to provide insight and action all across the organisation." — Alex Owens, VP, Global Head of People Data Centres, Unilever
2. **IKEA Retail (Ingka Group) — Deepening Customer Engagement**
3. **Volvo Group — Harnessing Data for Leaner and Greener Future of Mobility**
4. **Chase Payment Solutions — Modernizing the Point-of-Sale Experience**
5. **Tiffany & Co. — Reimagining Luxury Craftsmanship** — "We valued the truly collaborative process from conception to delivery. The resulting experience beautifully emphasizes our core brand codes of craftsmanship and heritage, while effectively leveraging new AI technologies." — Thomas Arnold, Digital Experience Design & Innovation Director
6. **Majid Al Futtaim / Carrefour — Helping Healthier Habits Stick** — "Our 'Pick Your 5' framework, based on your behavior change strategy, is going to be instrumental in driving positive outcomes." — Sheila Chaiban, Global CMO

Additional projects: Designing Robots for Human Spaces · Harboring Culture Year-Round (Destination NSW)

## CTA Banner
Title: "Let's work together"
Body: "Reach out to our global team to imagine, make and scale new products, services, experiences, business models, ventures and ways of working."
CTA: "Get in touch"

## How We Work
Headline: **Advancing people and planet**
Body: "The disruptive forces of emerging technologies and sustainable objectives present a reinvention imperative for businesses—and the potential to create entirely new dimensions of value. Navigate the dual transition of the eco-digital era with innovative solutions to today's biggest challenges."
CTA: "Explore our services"

## Latest Insights
Section title: "Latest insights"
Subtitle: "Explore research, provocations and perspectives on trends across technology, creativity, business and culture."

| Type | Title | CTA |
|------|-------|-----|
| Podcast | Ep. 58 — When Human Connection Meets AI | Listen |
| Podcast | Ep. 57 — Writing the Future of AI | Listen |
| Article | Amplifying Clinical Care with AI | Read |
| Podcast | Ep. 56 — The Future of Customer Experience | Listen |
| Article | Next-Gen Contact Centers: Powered by AI | Read |
| Article | The AI-Empowered Marketer | Read |
| Podcast | Ep. 55 — What Makes a Product Great? | Listen |
| Insight Report | From Complexity to Clarity | Download |

## Our Principles

1. **Challenge the status quo** — From launching game-changing products and services to redefining business as usual, our work bridges the gap between what could be and what should be.
2. **Fuse art & science to make ideas real** — We innovate with equal parts expertise in creativity and transformation, leveraging next-level data and tech to elevate experiences for all.
3. **Create a lasting impact at global scale** — Driving meaningful outcomes starts with reimagining systems at a fundamental level. As part of Meridian Consulting, we bring a global reach and diverse skillsets to our approach.
4. **Regenerate systems & communities** — In the eco-digital era, we believe every collaboration is an opportunity to create social, economic and environmental value for all.

## Navigation
Primary: Insights · Work · Services · Culture · Make Your Mark · Contact Us
Language selector: Global EN · France FR · China CN

## Footer
CTA 1: "Ready to make your mark? As your reinvention and experience partner, our global team is here to help." → "Get in touch"
CTA 2: "Do your best work among a caring community of diverse talents." → "Join our team"

Links: Studios · Culture · DE&I · Play

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <meta name="description" content="Leap Studio is a global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era.">

  <!-- Open Graph -->
  <meta property="og:title" content="Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner">
  <meta property="og:description" content="A global creative agency fusing design, strategy, and technology across 30+ studios worldwide.">
  <meta property="og:type" content="website">
  <meta property="og:url" content="https://www.leapstudio.com/">
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://www.leapstudio.com/og-image.jpg">

  <!-- JSON-LD Organization Schema -->
  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Leap Studio",
    "url": "https://www.leapstudio.com",
    "description": "A global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era.",
    "parentOrganization": {
      "@type": "Organization",
      "name": "Meridian Consulting Group"
    },
    "sameAs": []
  }
  </script>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --bg: #0A0A0A;
      --bg-elevated: #141414;
      --bg-card: #1A1A1A;
      --bg-card-hover: #222222;
      --text-primary: #FFFFFF;
      --text-secondary: #A0A0A0;
      --text-muted: #666666;
      --accent: #3B82F6;
      --accent-hover: #60A5FA;
      --accent-warm: #F59E0B;
      --border: #2A2A2A;
      --border-light: #333333;
      --font: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      --max-width: 1400px;
      --section-padding: clamp(80px, 10vw, 140px);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; color: inherit; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    ul, ol { list-style: none; }

    .container {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px);
    }

    /* ===== HEADER / NAV ===== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px);
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .logo span { color: var(--accent); }

    .nav-desktop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; }

    .nav-desktop a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .nav-desktop a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }

    .lang-selector {
      position: relative;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .lang-selector-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .lang-selector-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    .lang-selector-btn svg {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .lang-selector.open .lang-selector-btn svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .lang-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 6px;
      min-width: 160px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      transition: all 0.2s;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }

    .lang-selector.open .lang-dropdown {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .lang-dropdown button {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .lang-dropdown button:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .lang-dropdown button.active { color: var(--accent); }

    .nav-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px 22px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* Mobile Nav */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      width: 28px;
      padding: 4px 0;
    }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }

    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      z-index: 999;
      padding: 40px clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px);
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .nav-desktop, .nav-cta-wrapper { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
    }

    /* ===== HERO CAROUSEL ===== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      padding-top: 72px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-slides {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero-slide {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
    }

    .hero-slide.active { opacity: 1; }

    .hero-slide-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      filter: brightness(0.35);
    }

    .hero-slide-bg::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--bg) 0%, transparent 50%);
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 100%;
      padding-bottom: clamp(60px, 8vw, 120px);
    }

    .hero-card {
      display: none;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .hero-card.active { display: block; }

    .hero-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero-desc {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    }

    .hero-cta svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .hero-indicators {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .hero-dot {
      width: 40px;
      height: 3px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.3s;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-dot.active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

    .hero-dot.active::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      height: 100%;
      width: 0%;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-radius: 3px;
      animation: hero-progress 6s linear forwards;
    }

    @keyframes hero-progress {
      to { width: 100%; }
    }

    /* ===== SECTION SHARED ===== */
    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== TEAM / GLOBAL STUDIOS ===== */
    .team-section {
      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-header {
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .region-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 32px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .region-tab {
      padding: 10px 22px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: all 0.25s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .region-tab:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted); color: var(--text-primary); }

    .region-tab.active {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
      border-color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .team-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .team-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding: 10px 0 30px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .team-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .team-regions { position: relative; }

    .team-region {
      display: none;
    }

    .team-region.active { display: block; }

    .team-card {
      flex: 0 0 clamp(300px, 35vw, 420px);
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
    }

    .team-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .team-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 280px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #334155);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-card-img::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59,130,246,0.15), rgba(245,158,11,0.1));
    }

    .team-card-img .initials {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .team-card-body { padding: 28px; }

    .team-card-quote {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 20px;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
    }

    .team-card-name {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .team-card-title {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .team-card-office {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .team-card-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .team-card-cta:hover { color: var(--accent-hover); }
    .team-card-cta svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* ===== WORK SHOWCASE ===== */
    .work-section {
      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .work-header {
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .work-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding-bottom: 30px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    .work-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .work-card {
      flex: 0 0 clamp(320px, 40vw, 500px);
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
    }

    .work-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .work-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 260px;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .work-card-body { padding: 28px; }

    .work-card-client {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .work-card-title {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .work-card-quote {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-style: italic;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .work-card-author {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    /* ===== CTA BANNER ===== */
    .cta-banner {
      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
    }

    .cta-banner-inner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 50%, #0f3460 100%);
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px) clamp(32px, 5vw, 72px);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cta-banner-inner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      right: -20%;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59,130,246,0.12), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .cta-banner-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .cta-banner-desc {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.3vw, 1.15rem);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      position: relative;
    }

    .cta-banner-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px 36px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      position: relative;
    }

    .cta-banner-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    }

    /* ===== HOW WE WORK ===== */
    .how-section {
      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
    }

    .how-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .how-visual {
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a, #1e3a5f);
      border-radius: 20px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .how-visual::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, rgba(59,130,246,0.2), transparent 60%),
                  radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(245,158,11,0.12), transparent 50%);
    }

    .how-content .section-subtitle { margin-bottom: 36px; }

    .how-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .how-cta:hover { color: var(--accent-hover); }
    .how-cta svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .how-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    }

    /* ===== INSIGHTS ===== */
    .insights-section {
      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
    }

    .insights-header { margin-bottom: 48px; }

    .insights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .insight-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
    }

    .insight-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .insight-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .insight-card-body { padding: 24px; }

    .insight-card-type {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .insight-card-type.podcast { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15); color: #a78bfa; }
    .insight-card-type.article { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color: var(--accent); }
    .insight-card-type.report { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color: var(--accent-warm); }

    .insight-card-title {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .insight-card-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .insight-card-cta:hover { color: var(--accent-hover); }
    .insight-card-cta svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* ===== PRINCIPLES ===== */
    .principles-section {
      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .principles-header { margin-bottom: 64px; }

    .principles-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 40px;
    }

    .principle-card { position: relative; }

    .principle-num {
      font-size: 4rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .principle-title {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .principle-desc {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 80px 0 40px;
    }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }

    .footer-brand-desc {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 20px;
      max-width: 360px;
    }

    .footer-cta-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding: 12px 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-cta-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
    }

    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-top: 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .footer-legal {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .footer-legal-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .footer-legal-links a {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-legal-links a:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    }

    /* ===== COOKIE BANNER ===== */
    .cookie-banner {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 20px clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px);
      z-index: 2000;
      transform: translateY(0);
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .cookie-banner.hidden { transform: translateY(100%); }

    .cookie-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .cookie-text {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .cookie-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }

    .cookie-btn {
      padding: 10px 22px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .cookie-btn-accept { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg); }
    .cookie-btn-accept:hover { background: #e0e0e0; }

    .cookie-btn-manage {
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .cookie-btn-manage:hover { border-color: var(--text-primary); color: var(--text-primary); }

    .cookie-btn-decline {
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .cookie-btn-decline:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* Responsive polish */

      .insights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .principles-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cookie-inner { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .cookie-actions { justify-content: center; }
    }

  <script>
    // ===== HERO CAROUSEL =====
    let currentSlide = 0;
    const totalSlides = 5;
    let heroTimer;

    function goToSlide(n) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide, .hero-card, .hero-dot').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      currentSlide = n;
      document.querySelector(`.hero-slide[data-slide="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelector(`.hero-card[data-card="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      const dot = document.querySelector(`.hero-dot[data-dot="${n}"]`);
      dot.classList.add('active');
      resetHeroTimer();
    }

    function nextSlide() {
      goToSlide((currentSlide + 1) % totalSlides);
    }

    function resetHeroTimer() {
      clearInterval(heroTimer);
      heroTimer = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
    }

    resetHeroTimer();

    // Touch/swipe for hero
    let heroTouchStart = 0;
    const heroEl = document.querySelector('.hero');
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { heroTouchStart = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = heroTouchStart - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) nextSlide();
        else goToSlide((currentSlide - 1 + totalSlides) % totalSlides);
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // ===== REGION TABS =====
    function switchRegion(region) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.region-tab[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.team-region').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.team-region[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
    }

    // ===== CAROUSEL NAV =====
    function scrollCarousel(id, dir) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const cardWidth = el.querySelector('.work-card').offsetWidth + 24;
      el.scrollBy({ left: dir * cardWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Drag scroll for work carousel
    const workCarousel = document.getElementById('workCarousel');
    let isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      isDown = true; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      startX = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeft = workCarousel.scrollLeft;
    });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      workCarousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - (x - startX);
    });

    // ===== LANGUAGE SELECTOR =====
    function toggleLang() {
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function selectLang(lang) {
      document.querySelector('.lang-selector-btn').childNodes[0].textContent = lang + ' ';
      document.querySelectorAll('.lang-dropdown button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.target.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.lang-selector')) {
        document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function closeMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.remove('open');
    }

    // ===== COOKIE BANNER =====
    function dismissCookies() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showCookieBanner() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // ===== SCROLL REVEAL =====
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
          entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.team-card, .work-card, .insight-card, .principle-card').forEach(el => {
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
      el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease, border-color 0.3s';
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {

  <script>
    // ===== HERO CAROUSEL =====
    let currentSlide = 0;
    const totalSlides = 5;
    let heroTimer;

    function goToSlide(n) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide, .hero-card, .hero-dot').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      currentSlide = n;
      document.querySelector(`.hero-slide[data-slide="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelector(`.hero-card[data-card="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      const dot = document.querySelector(`.hero-dot[data-dot="${n}"]`);
      dot.classList.add('active');
      resetHeroTimer();
    }

    function nextSlide() {
      goToSlide((currentSlide + 1) % totalSlides);
    }

    function resetHeroTimer() {
      clearInterval(heroTimer);
      heroTimer = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
    }

    resetHeroTimer();

    // Touch/swipe for hero
    let heroTouchStart = 0;
    const heroEl = document.querySelector('.hero');
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { heroTouchStart = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = heroTouchStart - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) nextSlide();
        else goToSlide((currentSlide - 1 + totalSlides) % totalSlides);
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // ===== REGION TABS =====
    function switchRegion(region) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.region-tab[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.team-region').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.team-region[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
    }

    // ===== CAROUSEL NAV =====
    function scrollCarousel(id, dir) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const cardWidth = el.querySelector('.work-card').offsetWidth + 24;
      el.scrollBy({ left: dir * cardWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Drag scroll for work carousel
    const workCarousel = document.getElementById('workCarousel');
    let isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      isDown = true; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      startX = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeft = workCarousel.scrollLeft;
    });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      workCarousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - (x - startX);
    });

    // ===== LANGUAGE SELECTOR =====
    function toggleLang() {
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function selectLang(lang) {
      document.querySelector('.lang-selector-btn').childNodes[0].textContent = lang + ' ';
      document.querySelectorAll('.lang-dropdown button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.target.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.lang-selector')) {
        document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function closeMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.remove('open');
    }

    // ===== COOKIE BANNER =====
    function dismissCookies() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showCookieBanner() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // ===== SCROLL REVEAL =====
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
          entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.team-card, .work-card, .insight-card, .principle-card').forEach(el => {
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
      el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease, border-color 0.3s';
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .how-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }

    .insights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .insight-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
    }

    .insight-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .insight-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .insight-card-body { padding: 24px; }

    .insight-card-type {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .insight-card-type.report { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color: var(--accent-warm); }

      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin-bottom: 18px;

      padding: var(--section-padding) 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .principles-header { margin-bottom: 64px; }

      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);

    .footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;

    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-top: 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);

    .footer-legal {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);

    .footer-legal-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .footer-legal-links a {

      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-legal-links a:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    }

    /* ===== COOKIE BANNER ===== */
    .cookie-banner {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 20px clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px);
      z-index: 2000;
      transform: translateY(0);
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .cookie-banner.hidden { transform: translateY(100%); }

    .cookie-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .cookie-text {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .cookie-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }

    .cookie-btn {

      font-weight: 600;

    .cookie-btn-accept { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg); }

  <script>
    // ===== HERO CAROUSEL =====
    let currentSlide = 0;
    const totalSlides = 5;
    let heroTimer;

    function goToSlide(n) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide, .hero-card, .hero-dot').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      currentSlide = n;
      document.querySelector(`.hero-slide[data-slide="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelector(`.hero-card[data-card="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      const dot = document.querySelector(`.hero-dot[data-dot="${n}"]`);
      dot.classList.add('active');
      resetHeroTimer();
    }

    function nextSlide() {
      goToSlide((currentSlide + 1) % totalSlides);
    }

    function resetHeroTimer() {
      clearInterval(heroTimer);
      heroTimer = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
    }

    resetHeroTimer();

    // Touch/swipe for hero
    let heroTouchStart = 0;
    const heroEl = document.querySelector('.hero');
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { heroTouchStart = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = heroTouchStart - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) nextSlide();
        else goToSlide((currentSlide - 1 + totalSlides) % totalSlides);
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // ===== REGION TABS =====
    function switchRegion(region) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.region-tab[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.team-region').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.team-region[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
    }

    // ===== CAROUSEL NAV =====
    function scrollCarousel(id, dir) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const cardWidth = el.querySelector('.work-card').offsetWidth + 24;
      el.scrollBy({ left: dir * cardWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Drag scroll for work carousel
    const workCarousel = document.getElementById('workCarousel');
    let isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      isDown = true; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      startX = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeft = workCarousel.scrollLeft;
    });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      workCarousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - (x - startX);
    });

    // ===== LANGUAGE SELECTOR =====
    function toggleLang() {
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function selectLang(lang) {
      document.querySelector('.lang-selector-btn').childNodes[0].textContent = lang + ' ';
      document.querySelectorAll('.lang-dropdown button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.target.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.lang-selector')) {
        document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function closeMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.remove('open');
    }

    // ===== COOKIE BANNER =====
    function dismissCookies() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showCookieBanner() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // ===== SCROLL REVEAL =====
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
          entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.team-card, .work-card, .insight-card, .principle-card').forEach(el => {
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
      el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease, border-color 0.3s';
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --bg: #0A0A0A;
      --bg-elevated: #141414;
      --bg-card: #1A1A1A;
      --bg-card-hover: #222222;
      --text-primary: #FFFFFF;
      --text-secondary: #A0A0A0;
      --text-muted: #666666;
      --accent: #3B82F6;
      --accent-hover: #60A5FA;
      --accent-warm: #F59E0B;
      --border: #2A2A2A;
      --border-light: #333333;
      --font: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      --max-width: 1400px;
      --section-padding: clamp(80px, 10vw, 140px);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-primary);

    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    ul, ol { list-style: none; }

    .container {

      margin: 0 auto;

      transition: background 0.3s;
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px);
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .logo span { color: var(--accent); }

    .nav-desktop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; }

      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;

    .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }

    .lang-selector {
      position: relative;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .lang-selector-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .lang-selector-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    .lang-selector-btn svg {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .lang-selector.open .lang-selector-btn svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .lang-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 6px;
      min-width: 160px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      transition: all 0.2s;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }

    .lang-selector.open .lang-dropdown {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .lang-dropdown button {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .lang-dropdown button:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .lang-dropdown button.active { color: var(--accent); }

    .nav-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px 22px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;

      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;

      right: 0;

  <!-- ====== COOKIE BANNER ====== -->
  <div class="cookie-banner" id="cookieBanner">
    <div class="cookie-inner">
      <p class="cookie-text">We use cookies to enhance your experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. By clicking "Accept All," you consent to our use of cookies.</p>
      <div class="cookie-actions">
        <button class="cookie-btn cookie-btn-decline" onclick="dismissCookies()">Decline All</button>
        <button class="cookie-btn cookie-btn-manage" onclick="dismissCookies()">Manage Settings</button>
        <button class="cookie-btn cookie-btn-accept" onclick="dismissCookies()">Accept All</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // ===== HERO CAROUSEL =====
    let currentSlide = 0;
    const totalSlides = 5;
    let heroTimer;

    function goToSlide(n) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide, .hero-card, .hero-dot').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      currentSlide = n;
      document.querySelector(`.hero-slide[data-slide="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelector(`.hero-card[data-card="${n}"]`).classList.add('active');
      const dot = document.querySelector(`.hero-dot[data-dot="${n}"]`);
      dot.classList.add('active');
      resetHeroTimer();
    }

    function nextSlide() {
      goToSlide((currentSlide + 1) % totalSlides);
    }

    function resetHeroTimer() {
      clearInterval(heroTimer);
      heroTimer = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
    }

    resetHeroTimer();

    // Touch/swipe for hero
    let heroTouchStart = 0;
    const heroEl = document.querySelector('.hero');
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { heroTouchStart = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = heroTouchStart - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) nextSlide();
        else goToSlide((currentSlide - 1 + totalSlides) % totalSlides);
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // ===== REGION TABS =====
    function switchRegion(region) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.region-tab[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.team-region').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`.team-region[data-region="${region}"]`).classList.add('active');
    }

    // ===== CAROUSEL NAV =====
    function scrollCarousel(id, dir) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const cardWidth = el.querySelector('.work-card').offsetWidth + 24;
      el.scrollBy({ left: dir * cardWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Drag scroll for work carousel
    const workCarousel = document.getElementById('workCarousel');
    let isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      isDown = true; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      startX = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeft = workCarousel.scrollLeft;
    });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDown = false; workCarousel.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    workCarousel.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x = e.pageX - workCarousel.offsetLeft;
      workCarousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - (x - startX);
    });

    // ===== LANGUAGE SELECTOR =====
    function toggleLang() {
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function selectLang(lang) {
      document.querySelector('.lang-selector-btn').childNodes[0].textContent = lang + ' ';
      document.querySelectorAll('.lang-dropdown button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.target.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.lang-selector')) {
        document.getElementById('langSelector').classList.remove('open');
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function closeMobileNav() {
      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.remove('open');
    }

    // ===== COOKIE BANNER =====
    function dismissCookies() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showCookieBanner() {
      document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // ===== SCROLL REVEAL =====
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
          entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.team-card, .work-card, .insight-card, .principle-card').forEach(el => {
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
      el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease, border-color 0.3s';
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
